cover_headline: Indian-American Lawmakers Join 63 in Congress Urging Faster Green Cards as Health Coverage Lapses
facts: Sixty-three members of Congress have urged USCIS to expedite green-card applications for legally present immigrants who are losing government-funded healthcare
The congressional release put the number facing Medicaid loss from October 1 at more than 281,000 people across nine states and Washington, DC
Indian-American lawmakers Raja Krishnamoorthi, Pramila Jayapal and Shri Thanedar were among the signatories

quote.text: Needless red tape should never be the determinant between life and death.
quote.speaker: Yvette D. Clarke

end.headline: Indian-American Lawmakers Join 63 in Congress Urging Faster Green Cards as Health Coverage Lapses
end.line: The letter asks USCIS Director Joseph Edlow for an emergency I-485 expedite pathway after October 1 healthcare cuts left legally present immigrants uninsured.
